base.name: base
base.title: Base Model
base.description: The PCDC data model represents a harmonized consensus data model developed across all participating PCDC disease groups and consortia. It serves as the canonical model from which disease-specific and dataset-specific views are derived.

aml.name: aml
aml.title: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
aml.description: The AML view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric acute myeloid leukemia experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Acute Myeloid Leukemia Consortium (INTERACT). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

gct.name: gct
gct.title: Germ Cell Tumors
gct.description: The GCT view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric germ cell tumor experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium (MaGIC). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

hl.name: hl
hl.title: Hodgkin Lymphoma
hl.description: The HL view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the Hodgkin Lymphoma Data Collaboration (NODAL). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

nbl.name: nbl
nbl.title: Neuroblastoma
nbl.description: The NBL view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric neuroblastoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Neuroblastoma Risk Group (INRG). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

nrsts.name: nrsts
nrsts.title: Non-rhabdomyosarcoma Soft Tissue Sarcomas
nrsts.description: The NRSTS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric non-rhabdomyosarcoma soft tissue sarcoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Soft Tissue Sarcoma Consortium (INSTRuCT). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

rms.name: rms
rms.title: Rhabdomyosarcoma
rms.description: The RMS view of the PCDC data model represents consensus data modeling by an international group of pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma experts and is maintained by Data for the Common Good (D4CG) at the University of Chicago in collaboration with the International Soft Tissue Sarcoma Consortium (INSTRuCT). It is based on the collective requirements of its contributors.

Person.description: A person record captures individual-level demographic characteristics associated with a study subject, including sex, race, and ethnicity.

Subject.description: A subject record represents the core participant-level entity in the model and contains identifiers, consortium participation, contributor information, and high-level follow-up status.

ExternalReference.description: An external reference record links a subject to identifiers, resources, or URLs maintained outside the PCDC model.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per ___ when instantiated

Study.description: A study record describes a subject’s enrollment or participation in a study, protocol, treatment arm, or related research context.

Timing.description: A timing record provides reusable temporal anchors for disease phases, courses, cycles, and other time-dependent observations.

OffProtocolTherapyStudy.description: An off-protocol therapy study record captures when and why a subject went off protocol therapy or off study.

SurvivalCharacteristic.description: A survival characteristic record captures follow-up, vital status, survival, loss to follow-up, and cause-of-death information.

FamilyMedicalHistory.description: A family medical history record captures relevant familial cancer or medical history for a subject.

MedicalHistory.description: A medical history record captures prior or concurrent medical conditions and related history relevant to the subject.

Vital.description: A vital record captures vital sign measurements and related quantitative or categorical results.

FunctionTest.description: A function test record captures functional assessments, test categories, and associated results.

Lab.description: A lab record captures laboratory assessments, specimen context, methods, and qualitative or quantitative laboratory results.

MolecularAnalysis.description: A molecular analysis record captures cytogenetic, genomic, and molecular findings, including tested abnormalities, genes, variants, and related results.

Biospecimen.description: A biospecimen record describes available biological specimens and associated storage, media, type, and quantity information.
comments: D4CGNote: One observation/row per biospecimen when instantiated

Immunohistochemistry.description: An immunohistochemistry record captures IHC assessments, tested markers, and reported results.

Cytology.description: A cytology record captures cytologic assessments, specimen context, and the presence or absence of malignant cells.

Imaging.description: An imaging record captures imaging assessments, modalities, results, and disease-specific imaging scores.

Histology.description: A histology record captures pathologic and morphologic tumor findings, including histology, grade, morphology codes, and related results.

Staging.description: A staging record captures disease stage and staging-system information used to classify disease extent.

DiseaseCharacteristic.description: A disease characteristic record captures disease-defining clinical features, risk factors, disease sites, symptoms, and classification variables.

MyeloidSarcomaInvolvement.description: A myeloid sarcoma involvement record captures the presence and site of myeloid sarcoma involvement.

TumorAssessment.description: A tumor assessment record captures tumor-level characteristics such as site, classification, laterality, size, invasion, nodal involvement, and related findings.

LesionCharacteristic.description: A lesion characteristic record captures lesion-level disease findings, including lesion site, classification, measurements, effusions, and lesion response.

BiopsySurgicalProcedure.description: A biopsy or surgical procedure record captures procedure timing, site, type, extent, margins, and related tumor specimen findings.

StemCellTransplant.description: A stem cell transplant record captures transplant type, source, donor relationship, HLA matching, conditioning, and related transplant details.

TransfusionMedicineProcedure.description: A transfusion medicine procedure record captures transfusion-related procedures, products, timing, and unit information.

RadiationTherapy.description: A radiation therapy record captures radiation treatment timing, site, dose, laterality, boost, energy type, and fractionation details.

TotalDose.description: A total dose record summarizes administered or intended systemic therapy dose over a defined treatment interval.

ProtocolTreatmentModifications.description: A protocol treatment modification record captures modifications to protocol therapy, including rationale, reason, toxicity details, and agent substitutions.

CellularImmunotherapy.description: A cellular immunotherapy record captures cellular immunotherapy timing and treatment type.

NonProtocolTherapy.description: A non-protocol therapy record captures therapy given outside protocol treatment, including timing and therapy type.

SubjectResponse.description: A subject response record captures disease response assessments, response criteria, methods, and response-related laboratory or clinical findings.

MinimalResidualDisease.description: A minimal residual disease record captures MRD assessments, methods, sample sources, results, sensitivity, and molecular markers.

SecondaryMalignantNeoplasm.description: A secondary malignant neoplasm record captures subsequent malignancy occurrence, type, morphology, site, and related classification details.

AdverseEvent.description: An adverse event record captures treatment- or disease-related adverse events, severity, attribution, outcome, interventions, pathogens, and GVHD-related details.

GrowingTeratomaSyndrome.description: A growing teratoma syndrome record captures the timing and treatment of growing teratoma syndrome.

LateEffects.description: A late effects record captures late effects, severity, details, and CTCAE version information.

demographics.title: Demographics
demographics.description: Demographics contains subject identity, enrollment, study participation, longitudinal episode structure, survival status, family and medical history, and other contextual information needed to interpret records across the model.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: Testing contains laboratory, pathology, genomic, functional, anthropometric, and specimen-related observations used to characterize subjects, disease biology, eligibility, monitoring, and research sample availability.

disease_attributes.title: Disease Attributes
disease_attributes.description: Disease Attributes contains diagnostic, staging, anatomic, histologic, biologic, risk, extent-of-disease, and disease-site concepts used to characterize the subject's cancer or cancer-related condition.

intervention.title: Intervention
intervention.description: Intervention contains treatment and procedure records, including surgery, medications, radiation therapy, transplantation, transfusion, cellular therapy, locoregional therapy, fertility preservation procedures, and protocol treatment modifications.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Monitoring contains response, residual disease, toxicity, late effects, subsequent neoplasms, reproductive outcomes, patient-reported outcomes, and other follow-up concepts used to evaluate disease course and treatment impact over time.
